description: MikroTik RouterOS static DNS, /ip/dns/static, through its API. RouterOS matches a name's records by its exact spelling, capitals included: when a hostname's capitals change in the configuration, the old records stay, and must be removed by hand. See docs/mikrotik.md.

address.description: The router, with a port unless it's the default: 8728, or 8729 with TLS.

use_tls.description: Whether to use the API over TLS, the api-ssl service. Without it, the password crosses the network unencrypted.

tls_fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint of the router's certificate, in hex. With it, only that certificate is accepted, valid or not. Without it, the certificate must be valid. It needs use_tls: true.

username.description: A user with the read, write and api policies.

zone.description: The zone of the names, as lan.
